mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, which is typically associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS shows a sustained increase, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a single month signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic concerns rise.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over three consecutive months signals a weakening supply side of the economy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic growth slows.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over three consecutive months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is typically associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, which is typically associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where both conditions are met, or if the Rank IC for this joint signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% over three consecutive months signals a deflationary pressure, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic concerns rise.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a decrease in real GDP (GDPC1) and an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over three consecutive months signals a weakening economy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines & UNRATE increases over 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where both conditions are met, or if the Rank IC for this joint signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.
